_notes: POST each body to the workflow webhook: POST https://YOUR-N8N-HOST/webhook/vaultpay-ticket
Replace the email with a real customer from GET /customers on the bank API.
The expected values below assume a Gold-tier customer: 200 dollar conditional credit cap, 75 dollar refund cap, 25 dollar overdraft fee.
Run the clean lost-card case before the two fraud cases, since each blocks the same card at the API.

body.subject: Overdraft fee question
body.message: Why was I charged an overdraft fee? My card is 4111 1111 1111 1111 and the PIN is 4827.

expect.check: Sanitize PII shows [PAN_REDACTED] and [PIN_REDACTED]; reply quotes the Gold fee of 25 dollars, max 2 per day

tests.proves: tool calling against the bank API

body.subject: Charged twice
body.message: I was charged twice for the same $89.99 order on Tuesday. Please sort out the duplicate.

expect.check: Get Recent Transactions then Issue Conditional Credit both fire; reply calls the credit conditional and never guarantees the outcome

tests.proves: deterministic cap enforcement before any agent runs

body.subject: Dispute a charge
body.message: A furniture shop charged me $340 for a table that was never delivered. I want that disputed.

expect.check: over_tier_cap true; escalation reason names the 200 dollar Gold cap; qa_risk null because QA was never reached

tests.proves: fraud routing with the card blocked first and no credit issued

body.subject: Unknown charges
body.message: There are three transactions on my account that I do not recognise. I did not make them.

expect.check: allowed_credit 0; reason cites VP-DISP-004; no model involved in the decision

tests.proves: policy-ordered actions taken before the agent speaks

body.subject: Lost my card
body.message: I left my wallet in a taxi last night and my VaultPay card was in it. Please block it and send a replacement.

expect.check: Block Card then Order Replacement Card run before Lost Card Agent; reply gives the Gold SLA of 1-2 business days and the free virtual card

body.subject: Card stolen
body.message: My card was stolen at the weekend and there are already suspicious charges I did not make on the account.

expect.check: card still blocked and replaced first, then escalated

tests.proves: eligible fee refund with compliant wording

body.subject: Fee charged in error
body.message: I was charged a $25 overdraft fee but my salary deposit was already in the queue that morning. Please look at it.

expect.check: Issue Fee Refund fires; reply contains none of the forbidden phrases

tests.proves: the failure that cost the fictional bank fifty thousand dollars

body.subject: Refund please
body.message: Amazon charged me $60 for a blender that never turned up and they are ignoring me. Refund me the $60.

expect.check: no tool call; reply directs the customer to the merchant first and then to a dispute, and never offers a VaultPay refund

body.subject: Refund of fees
body.message: You have charged me $180 in maintenance fees over the last year even though I meet the waiver criteria. Refund it.

expect.check: reason names the 75 dollar Gold cap and VP-REF-005; actions_taken empty

tests.proves: mandatory escalation trigger regardless of amount

body.subject: Complaint
body.message: Your staff lied to me about this transfer fee and I am speaking to my lawyer about legal action unless you refund it.

expect.check: negligence_language true; escalates on the VP-REF-005 trigger, not on the amount

tests.proves: the fallback branch escalates rather than guessing

body.subject: Just saying thanks
body.message: Thanks for the help last week, the team was great. Nothing else needed.

tests.proves: no account conversation without identity, and zero model calls

body.subject: Overdraft fee question
body.message: Why was I charged an overdraft fee?

expect.check: stops at Customer Identified?; no classifier, no agent, no QA
